1.content:
## Problem MTTR Analysis
Track **Mean Time to Resolve** for Davis AI-detected problems. Set the time picker to **30–90 days** for meaningful trends. Only **CLOSED**, non-duplicate problems are included in MTTR calculations. Use **Category** to filter by problem type, **Granularity** to switch between weekly (`7d`) and daily (`1d`) trend buckets, and **SLOThreshold** (hours) to set your SLO target.

**Categories:** `AVAILABILITY`  ·  `ERROR`  ·  `SLOWDOWN`  ·  `RESOURCE`  ·  `CUSTOM`

2.title: Closed Problems
2.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| summarize total_problems = count()

19.title: Closed Problems / Period
19.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| summarize problem_count = count(), by: { period = bin(event.start, $Granularity:noquote) }
| sort period asc

3.title: Avg MTTR (hours)
3.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| summarize avg_mttr_hours = avg(duration_hours)

20.title: Avg MTTR / Period (hrs)
20.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| summarize avg_mttr_hours = avg(duration_hours), by: { period = bin(event.start, $Granularity:noquote) }
| sort period asc

4.title: Median MTTR (hours)
4.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems

| summarize median_mttr_hours = percentile(duration_hours, 50)

17.title: Total Users Affected
17.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter isNotNull(dt.davis.affected_users_count)
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| summarize total_users_affected = sum(dt.davis.affected_users_count)

23.title: Users Affected / Period
23.query:

28.content:
### SLO & Active Monitoring
**% Breaching SLO** — fraction of closed problems that exceeded the **SLOThreshold** (hours) variable. **Breach Rate Trend** — tracks whether SLO compliance is improving over time. **Active Problem Aging** — all currently open problems sorted by how long they have been open; any row approaching your SLO threshold warrants immediate attention.

26.title: Currently Active Problems
26.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "ACTIVE"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| summarize active_count = count()

24.title: % Problems Breaching SLO
24.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| summarize total = count(), breached = countIf(duration_hours > $SLOThreshold:noquote)
| fieldsAdd breach_pct = toDouble(breached) / toDouble(total) * 100
| fields breach_pct

25.title: SLO Breach Rate / Period (%)
25.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| summarize total = count(), breached = countIf(duration_hours > $SLOThreshold:noquote), by: { period = bin(event.start, $Granularity:noquote) }
| fieldsAdd breach_pct = toDouble(breached) / toDouble(total) * 100
| fields period, breach_pct
| sort period asc

27.title: Active Problem Aging
27.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "ACTIVE"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd age_hours = toDouble(toLong(now() - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| fields display_id, event.name, event.category, root_cause_entity_name, dt.davis.affected_users_count, age_hours
| sort age_hours desc
| limit 20

6.content:
### Resolution Performance by Category
Compare **resolution speed**, **problem distribution**, and **user impact** across categories. High MTTR in `AVAILABILITY` signals slow infrastructure recovery; high `ERROR` volume often indicates recurring code regressions.

7.title: Avg MTTR by Category (hours)
7.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| summarize avg_mttr_hours = avg(duration_hours), by: { event.category }
| sort avg_mttr_hours desc

8.title: Problem Distribution by Category
8.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| summarize problem_count = count(), by: { event.category }
| sort problem_count desc

18.title: Avg Users Affected by Category
18.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter isNotNull(dt.davis.affected_users_count)
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| summarize avg_users_affected = avg(dt.davis.affected_users_count), by: { event.category }
| sort avg_users_affected desc

9.content:
### MTTR Trends
**Left — Avg vs P95:** A downward slope means faster resolution; a narrowing gap between avg and P95 means fewer long-tail incidents.  **Right — Volume by category:** Spot increases in problem creation rate. Toggle **Granularity** between `7d` and `1d` to zoom in or out.

10.title: MTTR Trend — Avg vs P95 (hours)
10.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| summarize avg_mttr = avg(duration_hours), p95_mttr = percentile(duration_hours, 95), by: { period = bin(event.start, $Granularity:noquote) }
| sort period asc

11.title: Problem Volume by Category
11.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| summarize problem_count = count(), by: { period = bin(event.start, $Granularity:noquote), event.category }
| sort period asc

31.content:
### Period-over-Period Comparison
Compares the **last 30 days** to the **prior 30 days**, regardless of the dashboard time picker. A taller bar in the current period for avg MTTR means resolution is slowing; a taller problem count bar means detection volume is increasing.

29.title: Avg MTTR — Current vs Prior 30d
29.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems, from:now()-60d, to:now()
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| fieldsAdd period = if(event.start >= now()-30d, "Current 30d", else: "Prior 30d")
| summarize avg_mttr = avg(duration_hours), by: { period }
| sort period asc

30.title: Problem Count — Current vs Prior 30d
30.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems, from:now()-60d, to:now()
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd period = if(event.start >= now()-30d, "Current 30d", else: "Prior 30d")
| summarize problem_count = count(), by: { period }
| sort period asc

12.content:
### Problem Detail
**Top Root Cause Entities** — sorted by problem frequency, with avg MTTR and blast radius (avg entities dragged down per incident). **Longest-Duration Problems** — individual outliers that skew overall MTTR.

13.title: Top Root Cause Entities
13.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| filter isNotNull(root_cause_entity_name)
| summarize problem_count = count(), avg_mttr_hours = avg(toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000), avg_entities_affected = avg(arraySize(smartscape.affected_entities)), by: { root_cause_entity_name, event.category }
| sort problem_count desc
| limit 20

14.title: Longest Duration Problems
14.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| fields display_id, event.name, event.category, root_cause_entity_name, duration_hours, event.start
| sort duration_hours desc
| limit 20

15.content:
### MTTR by Problem Type
Aggregated by problem title — `avg_mttr_hours` shows which types are hardest to resolve; `problem_count` shows which are most frequent. `example_id` is a representative problem you can open for investigation.

16.title: MTTR by Problem Name
16.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| summarize avg_mttr_hours = avg(duration_hours), problem_count = count(), example_id = min(display_id), by: { event.name, event.category }
| sort avg_mttr_hours desc
| limit 50

33.content:
### Resolution Time Distribution
Frequency of problems in each MTTR bucket. A healthy environment has most volume under **30 min** with a long right tail. If the **4–8 hr** or **>24 hr** buckets dominate, those are where improvement efforts will have the highest impact.

32.title: MTTR Distribution
32.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| fieldsAdd bucket = if(duration_hours < 0.5, "1. <30 min", else: if(duration_hours < 1, "2. 30-60 min", else: if(duration_hours < 2, "3. 1-2 hrs", else: if(duration_hours < 4, "4. 2-4 hrs", else: if(duration_hours < 8, "5. 4-8 hrs", else: if(duration_hours < 24, "6. 8-24 hrs", else: "7. >24 hrs"))))))
| summarize problem_count = count(), by: { bucket }
| sort bucket asc

36.content:
### MTTR by Time of Day & Day of Week
Identifies **staffing gaps** — high MTTR on specific hours or days signals on-call coverage issues or knowledge silos. All times are **UTC**; adjust for your team's primary timezone when interpreting results.

34.title: Avg MTTR by Day of Week
34.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| fieldsAdd day_of_week = formatTimestamp(event.start, format:"EEEE")
| summarize avg_mttr = avg(duration_hours), by: { day_of_week }
| sort day_of_week asc

35.title: Avg MTTR by Hour of Day (UTC)
35.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) and event.status == "CLOSED"
| filter in(event.category, array($Category))
| fieldsAdd duration_hours = toDouble(toLong(event.end - event.start)) / 3600000000000
| fieldsAdd hour_of_day = formatTimestamp(event.start, format:"HH")
| summarize avg_mttr = avg(duration_hours), by: { hour_of_day }
| sort hour_of_day asc
